photos.title: River Oaks from above
photos.what: River Oaks from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): rows of condo buildings wind along a road between the fairways of the old golf course, with pools and tennis courts among them; the Intracoastal Waterway runs along the lower right, and the Waterway Village buildings sit on its edge.
photos.caption: River Oaks when the golf course was still open: condo buildings among the fairways, and the Intracoastal Waterway at the lower right.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of River Oaks in Myrtle Beach: rows of condo buildings along a curving road between golf fairways, with pools and tennis courts, and the Intracoastal Waterway at the lower right
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-15; the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the NAIP records of /submarkets/garden-city/ (data/2026-11-a/submarkets-garden-city/photos.json): The National Map offers free downloads of public domain NAIP orthoimagery; the USDA FSA policy page says public domain information may be freely distributed or copied, with credit requested.
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS).
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty cut this view from the NAIP service and resized it
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /submarkets/carolina-forest/river-oaks/ on 2026-11-15. Buildings, roads, fairways, pools and the waterway only. No person; no readable sign, plate or house number at page size. The frame also holds streets of other neighborhoods at the top left and across the water; the caption names only what is River Oaks.
photos.crop_note: Crops cut from the center of a second export of the same frame at 1800 x 1350 (crop_source_request) by tools/photos.js crops, for Article.image and the share image.
